_readme: LACCD class schedule search, probe (S736, Sam's ruling r-schedule-tool-first-for-subject-titles-sam-2026-11-26). The district's PeopleSoft guest class search lists each subject code a college schedules beside its title. Page 1 loads Pierce's search for term 2268 with no subject and prints every select whole (the subject list, the campus list); page 2 loads Sam's example (OLD ADL 029CE at Pierce) to see whether a course's result or detail prints its description. Reads only; no model call.

questions.subjects: Every subject code the search lists for the campus and term, with its title.
questions.campuses: The campus codes the search takes.
questions.descriptions: Whether a class result or its detail prints the course description.
